safety.title: Safety Audio
safety.subtitle: Record audio from your microphone for ride safety. Never starts silently. Files are private — not end-to-end encrypted.
safety.consentBody: This records audio from YOUR device microphone only, for ride safety. It does not start silently. Files are private (not public), stored securely, retained about 14 days, and only you (or MMD staff during a review) can download your file. The other party is notified when you start — their consent is separate and does not turn on their microphone.
safety.micBody: Allow microphone access to record a safety audio for this ride. You can enable it in iOS Settings if it was blocked.
safety.startedBody: Your microphone is recording now. A red Recording indicator stays visible until you stop. The other party is notified but cannot control your mic.
safety.otherActive: The other party started a safety recording on their device. Your microphone stays off unless you start yours.
safety.bgBody: Safety Audio records while MMD Delivery is open. Leaving the app or locking the screen may interrupt the recording — keep the app open to continue.
safety.notAllowed: Safety recording is not allowed in this area.
safety.stoppedOk: Recording stopped and stored securely. Only you can open your own recording from this screen.
safety.pendingBody: You are offline. The recording is kept on this device and will upload when network returns.
safety.videoSubtitle: Record an in-app front-camera video with audio for protection. Never starts silently.
safety.videoConsentBody: This uses your camera and microphone inside MMD Delivery only. The other party is notified. Consent is independent — their mic is not turned on by this action.
safety.videoActive: RECORDING — safety video is active (camera + mic). Tap Stop to end.
safety.videoMicBody: Allow microphone access for safety video audio. You can enable it in Settings if blocked.
safety.cameraBody: Allow camera access for in-app safety recording. Recording stays inside MMD Delivery.
